category: hosted workflow engine and script runner

free_tier.stated: Community plan on Windmill Cloud with no credit card: 1,000 free executions per user per month and 1,000 free executions per workspace per month; one execution is one job of up to 1 second on a worker with 2GB of memory, and each further second counts as another execution
free_tier.notes: An execution is also counted per second of job time, so the count is partly wall-clock. Job run details are kept 60 days. Windmill Cloud is hosted in the US.

per_object_cap.stated: unverified: the plan and getting-started pages quoted name no limit on a job's payload or result size

retention.stated: job run details are retained for 60 days on the Community plan (cloud)

egress.terms: not stated: the plan pages name no charge or cap on traffic out of a job

interface_detail: Every request to the Windmill API carries a Bearer user token, which can be scoped; the wmill CLI syncs scripts and authenticates with a user token
tooling: the Windmill web app, the REST API with user tokens and the wmill CLI
chaining: A hosted scheduler and script runner on a 2GB worker: 1,000 one-second jobs a month cover an hourly check that calls free APIs and writes to a free database.

limits.value: 1,000 free executions per user per month and 1,000 per workspace per month

binding_note: A job longer than one second counts once per second, so 1,000 executions is at most 1,000 seconds, about 16 minutes, of job time a month.

identity_cost.detail: No credit card required; sign-up with GitHub, GitLab, Google or Microsoft SSO, and the login page also offers a login without a third party.

reliability_note: no reliability event recorded; Windmill Cloud is hosted in the US

evidence.proved: the hosted Community plan starts with 1,000 monthly executions, needs no credit card and signs up with GitHub, GitLab, Google or Microsoft SSO
evidence.quote: no credit card required. Sign up using GitHub, GitLab, Google, or Microsoft SSO. Start with 1,000 monthly executions on our Community Plan, and easily upgrade for more.

evidence.proved: Windmill Cloud is hosted in the US
evidence.quote: Windmill cloud is hosted in the US.

evidence.proved: the Free plan in the Windmill app source gives 1,000 executions per user and 1,000 per workspace each month
evidence.quote: '1 000 free global executions per-user per month', '1 000 free executions per workspace per month'

evidence.proved: one execution is one job of up to 1 second on a 2GB worker, and each further second is another execution
evidence.quote: One execution equals one job up to 1 second on a worker with 2GB of memory, with each additional second counting as an extra execution.

evidence.proved: a workspace not on a paid plan draws on its users' free-tier quotas
evidence.quote: Users use their global free-tier quotas when doing executions in this workspace. Upgrade to a Team or Enterprise plan to unlock unlimited executions in this workspace.

evidence.proved: job run details are kept 60 days on the Community plan in the cloud
evidence.quote: Community plan (cloud): Jobs runs details are retained for 60 days.

evidence.proved: the cloud plans are Community, Team and Enterprise, and share most Enterprise features
evidence.quote: All Windmill cloud plans (Community, Team, Enterprise) have most of the Enterprise features.

evidence.proved: the Windmill API authenticates every request with a Bearer user token
evidence.quote: User tokens are used to authenticate API requests to Windmill. Every interaction with the Windmill API requires a `Bearer` token.

evidence.proved: the wmill CLI authenticates with a user token
evidence.quote: The Windmill CLI (`wmill sync push`/`pull`) and the [GitHub Action git sync](https://www.windmill.dev/docs/advanced/git_sync) authenticate with a user token.

evidence.proved: the login page offers GitHub, GitLab, Google, or a login without a third party
evidence.quote: Continue with GitHub Continue with GitLab Continue with Google or Log in without third-party

notes: Hosted: Windmill runs this plan, and the same offer is also recorded as compute/windmill-cloud. The open-source edition, which the user installs and runs, is compute/windmill and is the last resort after this hosted plan.
